bagPolicy.summary: All bags over 12″x12″x6″ are prohibited and subject to search upon entry. Guests can refuse a bag search, but the venue may deny entry.
prohibited: Food or drinks (except items on allowed list)
bagPolicy.note: Oversized items can be checked at Coat Check.

parking.note: Limited parking spaces are available on a first-come, first-served basis in designated lots. Lot A opens 1 hour before doors, Lot C and Lot D open at 6:00 PM on weeknights and 4:30 PM on weekends. Valet parking is also available and opens one hour before doors.

rideshare.note: Use Broad Street immediately south of Poplar Street for rideshare pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: The venue prohibits outside food or drinks, except for water in a factory sealed or empty bottle. Concession stands are available on all accessible seating levels, offering a variety of food and drink options.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking is in Lot A, first come, first served; tell parking staff, or be dropped off in front of the venue on Poplar Street. All levels except Loge are reachable by elevator, and if you have Loge seats but can't use stairs, go to the box office when you arrive. For ADA seating questions, get to the box office as early as possible on show day.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted. If you leave, you can't get back in without a new ticket.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is on Poplar Street, to the right of the main lobby doors, and opens two hours before doors on show days only. Will call is there; bring a photo ID matching the purchaser's name. Call 215-309-0112 with questions.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance is on Poplar Street, and the Premium/VIP entrance on Broad Street is only for VIP ticket holders. For general admission shows, line up no earlier than 8 AM on show day under the vertical Met sign on N. Broad Street, not at the Poplar entrance.
